source: Federal Reserve Summary of Economic Projections (SEP), released June 17, 2026 -- the median federal funds rate projection ('dot plot') from FOMC participants. This is the Fed's OWN stated projection, not market-implied probability (e.g. CME FedWatch), which has no free/legal API this project can use.
note: The SEP is only produced at 4 of the 8 annual FOMC meetings (March, June, September, December). This file must be manually updated after each of those meetings using the real, published projections from federalreserve.gov -- it will otherwise silently go stale, same maintenance pattern as economic_calendar.json.
context_note: The June 2026 SEP shifted notably more hawkish than March's: 9 of 18 participants projected at least one 2026 rate hike, versus March's median implying a cut. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh (new as of this meeting) did not submit a personal projection.
